LESSON: CIVIC ENGAGEMENT IN GOVERNANCE • SOCIAL JUSTICE • INTEGRITY • PEACE

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Political Developments and Governance
Topic 5.2: Civic Engagement in Governance • Social Justice • Integrity • Peace

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Civic Engagement in Governance • Social Justice • Integrity • Peace. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Civic Engagement in Governance • Social Justice • Integrity • Peace
2. Practise Civic Engagement in Governance • Social Justice • Integrity • Peace at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Civic Engagement in Governance • Social Justice • Integrity • Peace

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Civic Engagement in Governance • Social Justice • Integrity • Peace
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Civic Engagement in Governance • Social Justice • Integrity • Peace. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Civic Engagement in Governance • Social Justice • Integrity • Peace at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Civic Engagement in Governance • Social Justice • Integrity • Peace at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Civic Engagement in Governance • Social Justice • Integrity • Peace
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Civic Engagement in Governance • Social Justice • Integrity • Peace. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Civic Engagement in Governance • Social Justice • Integrity • Peace using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Civic Engagement in Governance • Social Justice • Integrity • Peace in the examples.
2. Explain Civic Engagement in Governance • Social Justice • Integrity • Peace to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Civic Engagement in Governance • Social Justice • Integrity • Peace.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Civic Engagement in Governance • Social Justice • Integrity • Peace using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Civic Engagement in Governance • Social Justice • Integrity • Peace important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Civic Engagement in Governance • Social Justice • Integrity • Peace
2. Practise Civic Engagement in Governance • Social Justice • Integrity • Peace at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Civic Engagement in Governance • Social Justice • Integrity • Peace

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
